subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should `openclaw agents set-identity --identity-file` intentionally reject previously accepted identity files larger than 2 MiB, with a hard diagnostic error rather than the prior unbounded read?
rationale: The cap is a sensible bounded-read defense, but it changes a public CLI input boundary for existing automation and user files; that compatibility choice requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the shared 2 MiB cap
options.body: Keep the bounded explicit-file behavior and its clear error after final-head CLI proof confirms the documented user outcome.

options.title: Preserve large explicit imports
options.body: Keep the workspace bootstrap cap but choose a separately reviewed policy for explicit `--identity-file` inputs if large identity files remain a supported CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared 2 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded explicit-file behavior and its clear error after final-head CLI proof confirms the documented user outcome.
